sanskrit_verse:
अन्वाहिते याचितके शिल्पिन्यासे सबन्धके ।
एष एवोदितो धर्मस् तथा च शरणागते ॥१८॥
transliteration: anvāhite yācitake śilpinyāse sabandhake | eṣa evodito dharmas tathā ca śaraṇāgate ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In every engagement initiated by invitation, in the placement of craftsmanship, in all contractual bonds, and equally in the case of one who has taken refuge—this alone is the declared Dharma.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises through conscious invocation and acceptance
Causation is established through mutual consent and alignment of purpose
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by the ability to fulfill the invoked role
Restoration logic operates through completion of the originally intended function
Consciousness alignment occurs when roles are executed with integrity to their origin
executable_legal_axioms: IF a party invokes another into a task, THEN that party assumes primary responsibility for enabling conditions.
IF craftsmanship is placed under bond, THEN the artisan's capacity must be verified prior to execution.
IF any party seeks refuge within a transactional or relational framework, THEN protection and support structures shall activate automatically.
IF a contract is formed, THEN restoration of its intent takes precedence over dissolution.
IF role misalignment occurs, THEN realignment protocols based on original capacity assessments shall be enforced.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that invocation, craftsmanship, contractual obligation, and asylum-seeking invoke equal dharmic weight. Responsibility is assigned not by fault but by the act of initiation or reception. The court must ensure that restoration of relational balance precedes procedural termination.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality recognizes the initiating act as the root of relational dharma. Anupūrvaśaḥ confirms sequential manifestation: invitation leads to commitment, which necessitates support. Proportional responsibility aligns with the initiator’s capacity to sustain the invoked process. Non-punitive reality rule ensures no suffering is induced; only completion and reintegration are mandated.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiation Verification Protocol: Confirm the clarity and sincerity of the initial call or request.
Craftsmanship Integrity Check: Validate the artisan’s alignment with the task and resources provided.
Bond Activation Sequence: Ensure contractual terms reflect mutual capacity and are actively supported.
Refuge Acknowledgment Mechanism: Recognize asylum-seekers immediately and initiate protective alignment.
Relational Completion Process: Facilitate full resolution of duties and dependencies before closure.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores balance through conscious completion, affirms non-punitivity as the foundation of justice, and establishes consciousness as the ultimate adjudicator.
